[BugFix][MRV2] Fix DSA prefill metadata propagation (#14211)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Fix DSA attention metadata handling in ModelRunner V2:

- Propagate each request's `is_prefilling` state from `AscendInputBatch`
into common DSA attention metadata.
- Apply the same propagation when building draft attention metadata for
MTP speculative decoding.
- Keep DSA sequence-length state under the DSA metadata builder instead
of applying the generic speculative-decoding update.
- Align the DSA KV-cache shape method signature with the current backend
interface.
- Add regression coverage for the default runner and MRV2 eager/FULL
graph metadata paths.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No public API change. This fixes DSA MRV2 runtime correctness for
prefill/decode state handling, including MTP speculative decoding.

### How was this patch tested?

- `pytest -sv tests/ut/worker/test_attn_utils_v2.py` — 5 passed with
vLLM v0.27.1.
- `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD` — passed.

- vLLM version: v0.27.1
- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/58d3918e3ea0a544ffedadad2ba84559e9c51d8f

Signed-off-by: leolee <yihao.li@huawei.com>
